response.sql: WITH large_trans AS (SELECT account_id, type, amount, balance FROM trans WHERE amount >= 2400), signed_trans AS (SELECT account_id, CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END AS signed_amount FROM large_trans WHERE type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')), signed_avgs AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(signed_amount) AS avg_signed FROM signed_trans GROUP BY account_id), balance_avgs AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance FROM large_trans GROUP BY account_id) SELECT AVG(avg_signed), AVG(avg_balance) FROM signed_avgs INNER JOIN balance_avgs ON signed_avgs.account_id = balance_avgs.account_id
